Humanoid (Halfling) · 1 hex · SM -2 Deep Halfling [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: humanoid folk and their sub-races; answers Deep Halfling (SRD 3.5)]

Halflings who took to stone instead of hedgerow, and who mine and trade with dwarves on terms the dwarves quietly consider generous. They see perfectly well underground, they move without disturbing gravel, and their reputation for cheerful harmlessness survives an astonishing amount of contrary evidence. The sling is the national weapon and they are frightening with it.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/deep-halfling.gct
  • Independent build total: 46 points of racial traits plus 30 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Deep Halfling (SRD 3.5). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 30 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 4 (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • About 0.9 m standing, which is the SM -2 row.
  • ST 8: a person who can carry a full ore basket at that mass and no more.
  • The sling is derived from ST rather than stated as literal dice, unlike this batch's bows: a sling's damage really does come from the arm swinging it.
